title: G27: retain runtime £5-cap failure and concurrent key-security tests
public_pr_body:
Adds real concurrent SQL execution beyond #375's source/unit review. Committed-code 7a63e36 run: 13 passed, 1 failed, zero skipped; overall exit 1. The strict provided-mode DEFAULT contract expected 10 accepted 50p requests/500p total but measured 20/1000p. This reproduces the existing default mismatch under concurrency; expected values remain 500p and application code is unchanged.

Passing checks cover shared mixed-feature ledgers at configured 500p, independent company budgets, concurrent settlement, replay refusal, stale-reservation charging, disabled company/global defaults, admin switch approval, no ciphertext in reservation/request/audit output and five synthetic-key error paths with console/outcome leak assertions. The main server path uses a fake provider, not the network.

Creates and identifies a fresh nonce-labelled, pinned-image network-isolated PostgreSQL container, no ports, before SQL. No DB URL accepted. Actual main 101/133/134 tables/functions and pinned public release 146 at 31f965e7 run against minimal synthetic prerequisites; unrelated 145 readiness dependency returns false. This is narrow DB execution, not full Supabase/Auth/browser/final-candidate deployment proof. Default-off checks do not establish actual launch settings.

G27: review done, one existing cap finding now reproduced at runtime; fixes pending owner. Explicitly configured 500p passes do not repair or approve the 1000p default, nor prove an immutable maximum against authorised cap changes. Original first/final logs, SQL hashes, exact commit/environment/times/exits and identity receipts retained in an evidence archive with SHA-256. Lint and TypeScript passed. Handover: tests/reviews/g27/README.md.

Separate branch from main 68f89ca. Tests/docs only; no edits to #359/candidate branch, implementation, production SQL, real keys/data, live AI, merge, Ready label, or message to John.
